message: Hey Jane, I've been thinking about Lisa lately. She seemed off last time we all hung out. Have you noticed anything? Hope she's doing okay.
Jane, I'm just feeling so overwhelmed with everything. My anxiety has been through the roof with all the personal stuff I'm dealing with.
I'm really sorry to hear that, Lisa. If you need to talk or anything, I'm here for you.
Thanks, Jane. That means a lot. On a brighter note, I'm adopting a dog from Happy Paws! Can't wait for you to meet him.
Reminder: Harmony Friends Club meeting this Thursday at 7 PM. Don't miss it!
Jane, have you read this book called 'Mindful Moments'? I think you'd like it.
Can't make it to the coffee catch-up tomorrow, got a doctor's appointment. Let's reschedule?
No worries, Jane. Health comes first. Let me know when you're free next week.
Hey, are we still on for the club meeting next Thursday?
Yes, Mark. Looking forward to it!
